title: [Subcontracting] Fix subcontracting order opening wrong purchase order after creation
summary: Fixed subcontracting order creation to open the newly created purchase order instead of displaying an old received one when production order quantity was increased after a previous subcontracting operation.
key_points: Subcontracting order creation now correctly opens the newly created purchase order when the production order quantity increases
The fix captures purchase orders created or updated in the current invocation before determining which ones to display
Filtering logic was aligned with existing PurchLineExists logic to only show open, unreceived lines
Fallback handling ensures the feature still works when an existing open PO is updated instead of creating a new one
Two integration tests were added to cover the delta-PO and updated-open-PO scenarios
